patch_description: Add an analytic Jacobian for the wall and Euclidean contact constraints, improving SLSQP’s ability to resolve the nearly tangent contact graph accurately. Also add several inexpensive deterministic seeds that place the 26th circle in different square-lattice interstices, with small asymmetric local perturbations. These explicitly explore distinct local contact graphs for the extra circle while retaining the strong 5-by-5 lattice basin.
